rules.title: PrismMetricsNoData

rules.description: A configured coordinator target has no native health family; restore scrape visibility. Preserves the deployed three-minute scrape coverage grace.
rules.basis: Preserves the deployed three-minute scrape coverage grace.

rules.title: PrismMetricsEndpointDown
rules.expr: up{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == bool 0
rules.description: Coordinator /metrics cannot be scraped; miner-impact paging remains with the sidecar. Preserves the deployed three-minute scrape outage grace.
rules.basis: Preserves the deployed three-minute scrape outage grace.

rules.title: PRISM Connected Clients
rules.expr: (qbit_prism_connections{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} < bool 10) and on(job, instance, network) ((qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 1) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_stale{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 0))

rules.basis: Deployed operator floor: ten clients for three minutes, now counted locally by the native registry.

rules.expr: qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_stale{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} > bool 0
rules.description: Snapshot stale means cached operational gauges cannot establish health. #277 computes staleness at scrape time from max(3 * health refresh, 15s); no copied age constant.
rules.basis: #277 computes staleness at scrape time from max(3 * health refresh, 15s); no copied age constant.

rules.title: PrismMetricsSnapshotUnavailable
rules.expr: qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == bool 0
rules.description: Snapshot unavailable means cached operational gauges cannot establish health. #277 computes staleness at scrape time from max(3 * health refresh, 15s); no copied age constant.
rules.basis: #277 computes staleness at scrape time from max(3 * health refresh, 15s); no copied age constant.

rules.title: PrismMetricsSnapshotAgeHigh
rules.expr: (qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_age_seconds{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} >= bool 0) * on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_stale{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == bool 1)
rules.description: Snapshot agehigh means cached operational gauges cannot establish health. #277 computes staleness at scrape time from max(3 * health refresh, 15s); no copied age constant.
rules.basis: #277 computes staleness at scrape time from max(3 * health refresh, 15s); no copied age constant.

rules.title: PrismShareAckP99High
rules.expr: ((histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (job, instance, network, le) (rate(qbit_prism_share_ack_seconds_bucket{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"}[5m]))) > bool 1) and on(job, instance, network) (sum by (job, instance, network) (increase(qbit_prism_share_ack_seconds_count{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"}[5m])) >= 100)) and on(job, instance, network) ((qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 1) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_stale{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 0))
rules.description: Frame receipt to completed response write, both results combined; durable credit can precede a failed write. Replaces writer-queue pressure with miner-visible latency. One-second histogram boundary; at least 100 completed ACKs in five minutes. Provisional, measure in #291.
rules.basis: One-second histogram boundary; at least 100 completed ACKs in five minutes. Provisional, measure in #291.

rules.title: PrismRejectRatioByReasonHigh
rules.expr: (((sum by (job, instance, network, reason_id) (increase(qbit_prism_rejections_total{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"}[5m])) / on(job, instance, network) group_left() (sum by (job, instance, network) (increase(qbit_prism_accepted_shares_total{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"}[5m])) + sum by (job, instance, network) (increase(qbit_prism_rejections_total{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"}[5m])))) > bool 0.05) and on(job, instance, network) ((sum by (job, instance, network) (increase(qbit_prism_accepted_shares_total{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"}[5m])) + sum by (job, instance, network) (increase(qbit_prism_rejections_total{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"}[5m]))) >= 100)) and on(job, instance, network) ((qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 1) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_stale{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 0))
rules.description: Preserves reason_id on each alert; rejected includes failed response writes. Diagnose ledger-confirmation-failed, backend-rpc-unavailable, stale-job, duplicate-share and low-difficulty separately. Five percent per canonical reason over five minutes, with at least 100 acceptance/rejection decisions. Provisional, measure in #291.
rules.basis: Five percent per canonical reason over five minutes, with at least 100 acceptance/rejection decisions. Provisional, measure in #291.

rules.title: PrismTimeToUsableWorkHigh
rules.expr: ((qbit_prism_stratum_oldest_pending_initial_job_seconds{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} > bool 15) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_stratum_pending_initial_jobs{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} > 0)) and on(job, instance, network) ((qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 1) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_stale{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 0))
rules.description: Reports miners awaiting first usable work, including reauthorization; -1 is unknown and snapshot coverage is required. Authorization to successfully written first job; 15 seconds is a provisional bound, measure in #291.
rules.basis: Authorization to successfully written first job; 15 seconds is a provisional bound, measure in #291.

rules.title: PrismCurrentWorkGapHigh
rules.expr: ((qbit_prism_stratum_current_tip_coverage_gap_seconds{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} > bool 15) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_authorized_clients{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} > 0)) and on(job, instance, network) ((qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 1) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_stale{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 0))
rules.description: Current-generation usable work remains missing; replaces the operational intent of refresh deadline rules, not Python refresh task state. Native timer advances only while semantic coverage is strictly below 0.95; 15-second duration is provisional, measure in #291.
rules.basis: Native timer advances only while semantic coverage is strictly below 0.95; 15-second duration is provisional, measure in #291.

rules.title: PrismSemanticWorkCoverageLoss
rules.expr: ((qbit_prism_stratum_semantic_current_work_ratio{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} < bool 0.95) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_stratum_semantic_current_work_ratio{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} >= 0) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_authorized_clients{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} > 0)) and on(job, instance, network) ((qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 1) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_stale{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 0))
rules.description: Unknown ratio -1 is excluded from coverage and reported separately; no-client ratio one is healthy. Native semantic generation coverage; warning matches the strict 95-percent timer boundary. Critical 50 percent and three-minute dwell: Provisional, measure in #291.
rules.basis: Native semantic generation coverage; warning matches the strict 95-percent timer boundary. Critical 50 percent and three-minute dwell: Provisional, measure in #291.

rules.title: PrismSemanticWorkCoverageLossCritical
rules.expr: ((qbit_prism_stratum_semantic_current_work_ratio{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} < bool 0.5) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_stratum_semantic_current_work_ratio{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} >= 0) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_authorized_clients{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} > 0)) and on(job, instance, network) ((qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 1) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_stale{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 0))
rules.description: Unknown ratio -1 is excluded from coverage and reported separately; no-client ratio one is healthy. Native semantic generation coverage; warning matches the strict 95-percent timer boundary. Critical 50 percent and three-minute dwell: Provisional, measure in #291.
rules.basis: Native semantic generation coverage; warning matches the strict 95-percent timer boundary. Critical 50 percent and three-minute dwell: Provisional, measure in #291.

rules.title: PrismWorkMetricsUnavailable
rules.expr: ((qbit_prism_stratum_semantic_current_work_ratio{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} < bool 0) + on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_stratum_oldest_pending_initial_job_seconds{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} < bool 0)) and on(job, instance, network) ((qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 1) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_stale{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 0))
rules.description: A published snapshot has not observed work delivery; inspect the publisher and delivery sampler. Unknown sentinels must never masquerade as healthy work coverage.
rules.basis: Unknown sentinels must never masquerade as healthy work coverage.

rules.title: PrismBlockCandidateBacklog
rules.expr: (qbit_prism_block_candidates_pending{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} >= bool 2) and on(job, instance, network) ((qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 1) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_stale{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 0)) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_collector_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__",collector="database"} == 1)
rules.description: Per-scrape-target view of cluster-wide backlog; do not sum repeated database snapshots across coordinators. Unknown -1 belongs to the collector-unavailable alert. Native pending outbox rows include claimed/retry-delayed candidates; count bounds 2/5 and age bounds 15/60 seconds. Provisional, measure in #291.
rules.basis: Native pending outbox rows include claimed/retry-delayed candidates; count bounds 2/5 and age bounds 15/60 seconds. Provisional, measure in #291.

rules.description: Per-scrape-target view of cluster-wide backlog; do not sum repeated database snapshots across coordinators. Unknown -1 belongs to the collector-unavailable alert. rules.expr: (qbit_prism_block_candidate_oldest_pending_seconds{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} >= bool 15) and on(job, instance, network) ((qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 1) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_stale{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 0)) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_collector_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__",collector="database"} == 1)
rules.description: Per-scrape-target view of cluster-wide backlog; do not sum repeated database snapshots across coordinators. Unknown -1 belongs to the collector-unavailable alert. Native pending outbox rows include claimed/retry-delayed candidates; count bounds 2/5 and age bounds 15/60 seconds. Provisional, measure in #291.

rules.title: PrismBlockCandidateOldestPendingCritical
rules.expr: (qbit_prism_block_candidate_oldest_pending_seconds{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} >= bool 60) and on(job, instance, network) ((qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 1) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_stale{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 0)) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_collector_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__",collector="database"} == 1)
rules.description: Per-scrape-target view of cluster-wide backlog; do not sum repeated database snapshots across coordinators. Unknown -1 belongs to the collector-unavailable alert. Native pending outbox rows include claimed/retry-delayed candidates; count bounds 2/5 and age bounds 15/60 seconds. Provisional, measure in #291.

rules.title: PrismBlockCandidateMetricsUnavailable
rules.expr: (qbit_prism_collector_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__",collector="database"} == bool 0) or on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_block_candidates_pending{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} < bool 0) or on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_block_candidate_oldest_pending_seconds{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} < bool 0)
rules.description: Database candidate age/count are unknown, not zero; collector state is live at scrape time. Collector failure, cancellation or expiry after 30 seconds invalidates both gauges.
rules.basis: Collector failure, cancellation or expiry after 30 seconds invalidates both gauges.

rules.title: PrismDatabasePoolWaitHigh
rules.expr: ((histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (job, instance, network, le) (rate(qbit_prism_database_pool_acquire_seconds_bucket{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"}[5m]))) > bool 0.5) and on(job, instance, network) (sum by (job, instance, network) (increase(qbit_prism_database_pool_acquire_seconds_count{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"}[5m])) >= 10)) and on(job, instance, network) ((qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 1) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_stale{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 0)) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_collector_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__",collector="database"} == 1)
rules.description: Only actual collector PgPool::acquire waits are timed. Cancellation is covered by collector availability; no advisory-lock rule until #283/A/C populate it. Pool p99 >0.5 seconds from at least ten completed acquisitions in five minutes; provisional, measure in #291.
rules.basis: Pool p99 >0.5 seconds from at least ten completed acquisitions in five minutes; provisional, measure in #291.

rules.title: PrismRuntimeLagHigh
rules.expr: (max_over_time(qbit_prism_runtime_lag_seconds{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"}[5m]) > bool 2) + on(job, instance, network) (max by (job, instance, network) (max_over_time(qbit_prism_runtime_poll_lag_seconds{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"}[5m])) > bool 2) + on(job, instance, network) (max by (job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_runtime_task_stalled{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"}) > bool 0) + on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_runtime_lag_seconds{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} < bool 0)
rules.description: Runtime scheduling pressure replaces writer-lease monitor wake delay. Scrape-time runtime signals deliberately remain active during snapshot staleness; retained completed polls capture recovery even when latest wake lag drops within 100ms. Two-second native blocked-poll budget; five-minute evidence window and three-minute dwell replace the legacy lease-wake episode, provisional, measure in #291. A runtime sampler that never observes a tick remains unknown and alerts after the same dwell.
rules.basis: Two-second native blocked-poll budget; five-minute evidence window and three-minute dwell replace the legacy lease-wake episode, provisional, measure in #291.

rules.title: PrismResidentMemoryHigh
rules.expr: (qbit_prism_process_resident_memory_bytes{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} > bool 4294967296) and on(job, instance, network) ((qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 1) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_metrics_snapshot_stale{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} == 0)) and on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_collector_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__",collector="process"} == 1)
rules.description: Linux process VmRSS, not heap allocation; a real zero is valid and unsupported/failed/stale collection is -1. Four GiB is an unqualified initial RSS bound; set against actual container headroom. Provisional, measure in #291.
rules.basis: Four GiB is an unqualified initial RSS bound; set against actual container headroom. Provisional, measure in #291.

rules.title: PrismProcessMetricsUnavailable
rules.expr: (qbit_prism_collector_available{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__",collector="process"} == bool 0) or on(job, instance, network) (qbit_prism_process_resident_memory_bytes{job="qbit-prism",network="__NETWORK__"} < bool 0)
rules.description: RSS cannot establish memory health until process collection succeeds. Process collector expires after 30 seconds or on failure; unsupported platforms are unknown.
rules.basis: Process collector expires after 30 seconds or on failure; unsupported platforms are unknown.

rules.title: PrismPublicStalenessRefusalsIncreasing
rules.expr: increase(qbit_prism_public_staleness_refusals_total{job="qbit-prism-public-read",network="__NETWORK__"}[5m]) > bool 0
rules.description: Cached public responses exceeded their route-specific budget. Any refusal is an actual endpoint staleness-budget breach; five-minute window is provisional, measure in #291.
rules.basis: Any refusal is an actual endpoint staleness-budget breach; five-minute window is provisional, measure in #291.

rules.title: PrismPublicLedgerUnready
rules.expr: (qbit_prism_public_ledger_ready{job="qbit-prism-public-read",network="__NETWORK__"} == bool 0) or on(job, instance, network) (0 * up{job="qbit-prism-public-read",network="__NETWORK__"} + 1)
rules.description: The public read probe is failed, unknown or stale; its freshness owner does not emit the coordinator snapshot gauges. Readiness already rejects missing/failed probes and ages >= max(3 * probe interval, 15s). Missing readiness on any configured scrape target also fires, even while another public instance is healthy.
rules.basis: Readiness already rejects missing/failed probes and ages >= max(3 * probe interval, 15s).

rules.title: PrismPublic5xxSustained
rules.expr: rate(qbit_prism_public_responses_total{job="qbit-prism-public-read",network="__NETWORK__",status=~"5.."}[5m]) > bool 0
rules.description: This response counter includes health probes; it is an error signal and is not divided by public_requests_total. Any sustained 5xx response, preserving deployed failure intent; five-minute window is provisional, measure in #291.
rules.basis: Any sustained 5xx response, preserving deployed failure intent; five-minute window is provisional, measure in #291.
